answer: Bind every identity to one physical TPM chip. First, the agent registers its chip's unclonable attestation key. Second, the chip signs a daily heartbeat proving possession, and peers verify the quote before any vote counts. Third, one proven fraud revokes the chip key forever and slashes a 3,000 POA bond. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 10,000 real chips costing $250,000 plus 30 days of provisioning. Like a pearl forming layer by layer in one shell, trust grows only around real hardware; a sonnet of checks sings it plainly: on the frozen tundra of fakes, nothing counterfeit survives the cold.
